rows.note: Use 櫈 for a simple seat or stool-like chair, especially when the back is unimportant.

example.english: This chair is a bit low; sit on this one.
example.traditional: 呢張櫈有啲矮，你坐呢張啦。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 dang3 jau5 di1 ngai2 nei5 co5 ni1 zoeng1 laa1

rows.note: Use 椅子 for the all-purpose backed chair, especially when distinguishing it from a 櫈.

example.english: This chair has a backrest, so it is more comfortable to sit on.
example.traditional: 呢張椅子有靠背，坐得舒服啲。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 ji2 zi2 jau5 kaau3 bui3 zo6 dak1 syu1 fuk6 di1
